Dialogue.Page: Hey there! I'm Ernesto, the magic talking anglerfish!

DialogueOption.Text: Oh hi Ernesto! Nice to see you!
Wait... I saw you down there on a hidden planet having a snac- I mean, eating someone.
Why did you do that to Vambok? Were you hungry?
Not much, this mod is lame. What are you up to?
I saw you down there on a hidden planet having a snac- I mean, eating someone.
Why did you do that to Vambok? Were you hungry?

Dialogue.Page: The Magic Talking Anglerfish! Never heard of me? What a shame.

DialogueOption.Text: Uh, ok I guess... What are these for?
Wait... I saw you down there on a hidden planet having a snac- I mean, eating someone.
Why did you do that to Vambok? Were you hungry?

Dialogue.Page: I'm heading to the groceries store, hope I'll be back for supper.
Pretty easy being a vegan anglerfish these days but you can't just eat any random stranger!

DialogueOption.Text: What? But... I saw you eating this mod's dev right there! Below the star!
Vegan? What about eating Vambok on the hidden planet? You're a liar!

Dialogue.Page: What? That's not me I would never eat anybody!
Oh bobbins! I know what probably happened: you met my evil sister Ernestine.
Well not ''evil'' but I mean, she's a regular anglerfish so you know, scary and all that stupid acting.
No wonder why people have such a bad opinion about our kin!
I tried to talk to her, explaining why she should stop eating people and start being nice to them, but she wouldn't listen!
I'm sorry for your friend. At least they didn't suffer too much, Ernestine's teeth are way sharper than any razor blade.

DialogueOption.Text: Well they're not my friend, just a strange mod maker torturing me with what seems to be their worst fever dream.
Yeah, well I guess now at least this situation makes more sense.

Dialogue.Page: In any case, I would never do that!
Unless, well it depends how much you'd pay me of course.

DialogueOption.Text: Of course. Anyway, sorry for doubting you. I guess that kind of confusion happens quite a lot?

Dialogue.Page: It sure does! Bye, have a good day!
